subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should be shown directly to users, and how should session or channel identifiers be redacted?
rationale: Current code already carries token, budget, provider/model, route, and session facts in logs or state, but exposing exact counts and identifiers changes privacy, support, and UX policy that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Show redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget or model limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep specifics operator-only
options.body: Leave chat copy generic and document the log, status, or diagnostic path operators should use for detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Fold into broader context visibility
options.body: Defer this issue until a broader context-visibility design decides shared UI, logs, and channel-message behavior together.

recommendation.title: Show redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget or model limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.
